name: @feldspar/astro
title: Astro (websites)
description: Build a website — a landing page, a blog, a news page, a contact form — in Astro's .astro syntax, rendered on the server for fast, search-friendly pages.
supplies: An application framework, "Astro (website)": pages in .astro files whose frontmatter reads the database like a JavaScript code action; pages without live data are prerendered at build time, the rest are rendered per request; scoped styles, bundled scripts, a sitemap and robots.txt.
Two tables for A/B tests of landing pages, astro_exposures and astro_conversions: which variant of an <Optimise> each visitor was shown, and the goals they reached.
